notes.title: THE DOORS TO PURGATORY ARE NOW OPEN!
notes.content:
[h3]We're proud to announce that [b]Doors of Insanity: ReOpened is officially OUT NOW with a hefty 40% launch discount![/b][/h3] 

This game is our love child, and a tribute to  roguelike deckbuilders with just a sprinkle of RPG elements. 

[previewyoutube=ZUIJeeB-S-s;full][/previewyoutube]

It's a total reimagining of OneShark’s original Doors of Insanity — the ReOpened version has[b] new mechanics, cards, enemies, equipment, and more[/b], created by a small and passionate team within Neon Doctrine! 

[h3]Don't worry though, [b]if you previously bought the original Doors of Insanity, you're getting ReOpened for free[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247827/ad2a3f40ab85f0df89c4e1ca5c7bb122efbe763c.gif[/img]

Have fun meeting and beating weirdos in Purgatory, and don't forget to enjoy while you're there!

Remember to follow our [i][url=https://neondoctrine.games/m/links]socials[/url][/i] for more updates on cool games!

With love, 
Neon Doctrine💜

notes.title: OUR PLAYTEST IS NOW REOPENED!
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers,

The door to the [b]PLAYTEST[/b] of the half-remake, half-sequel Doors of Insanity: ReOpened is now open!

There are infinite doors you can open, but be careful; each door could hide a mad monster, a mythic weapon, or… a weirdo!

This humble tribute to roguelite deckbuilders is a passion project from a small team within Neon Doctrine who reimagined and added their unique take to OneShark’s original creation.

[list]
[*] Completely reimagined Mechanics
[*] Over 100 new Cards with powerful Synergies
[*] New Equipment system that affects your Cards
[*] New Dice system to spice up your turns
[*] New Enemies with devious new tactics
[*] Full Controller Support
[*] UI and Quality of Life adjustments
[/list]
Feel free to leave your feedback in our Discord down below!

And be sure to click [b]'Request Access'[/b] to gain access to the playtest!
